XData.name: DTL
XData.Data:
<transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='DemogrInitiate:Demogr_Generic' targetDocType='DemogrInitiate_To_AmWell:InitiateDemogrToAmWell' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Maps Initiate Demographics Hl7 to AmWell </annotation> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <trace value='"MsgType in DTL..."_source.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' /> <if condition='source.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}="A04"' > <true> <assign value='"A31"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}="A08"' > <true> <assign value='"A31"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}="A18"' > <true> <assign value='"A30"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <trace value='" Target MsgType in DTL..."_target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' /> <assign value='"INTERFACEENGINE"' property='target.{MSH:SendingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' property='target.{EVN:EventTypeCode}' action='set' /> <assign value='"INTERMOUNTAIN"' property='target.{MSH:SendingFacility.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"CONNECTCARE"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"AMWELL"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingFacility.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"1"' property='target.{PID:SetIDPID}' action='set' /> <trace value='"AmWell MRN..."_context.amwellMrn' /> <assign value='context.ihcEmpi' property='target.{PID:PatientID.ID}' action='set' /> <trace value='"IHC empi..."_context.ihcEmpi' /> <assign value='context.amwellMrn' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(1).ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientName(1).familyname.surname}' property='target.{PID:PatientName(1).familyname.surname}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientName(1).givenname}' property='target.{PID:PatientName(1).givenname}' action='set' /> <if condition='source.{PID:PatientName(1).secondandfurthergivennamesor}'=""' > <true> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientName(1).secondandfurthergivennamesor}' property='target.{PID:PatientName(1).secondandfurthergivennamesor}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.{PID:PatientName(1).prefix}'=""' > <true> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientName(1).prefix}' property='target.{PID:PatientName().prefix}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.{PID:DateTimeOfBirth.timeofanevent}'=""' > <true> <assign value='source.{PID:DateTimeOfBirth.timeofanevent}' property='target.{PID:DateTimeOfBirth.timeofanevent}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.{PID:AdministrativeSex}' property='target.{PID:AdministrativeSex}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress(1).streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress(1).otherdesignation}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).otherdesignation}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress(1).city}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).city}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress(1).stateorprovince}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).stateorprovince}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress(1).ziporpostalcode}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).ziporpostalcode}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(1).phonenumber1}' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(1).phonenumber1}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(1).Emailaddress}' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(1).Emailaddress}' action='set' /> <trace value='"Found MRG segment..."' /> <assign value='source.{MRG:PriorPatientIdentifierList(1).ID}' property='mrgPatientId' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(mrgPatientId) > 1' > <true> <assign value='mrgPatientId' property='target.{MRG(1):PriorPatientID.ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(1).ID}' property='target.{MRG(1):PriorPatientIdentifierList(1).ID}' action='set' /> </true> </if>
<assign value='source.{EVN:RecordedDateTime.timeofanevent}' property='target.{EVN:RecordedDateTime.timeofanevent}' action='set' />
</transform>
